mapper.sql: t.*, e.actual_name AS assignee_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM sorting_task_item i WHERE i.task_id=t.id AND i.deleted=FALSE) AS item_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM sorting_task_item i WHERE i.task_id=t.id AND i.deleted=FALSE AND i.occupation_status='ACTIVE' AND i.result IS NOT NULL) AS processed_count
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sorting_task WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT
FROM sorting_task t LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id=t.assignee_employee_id AND e.deleted_flag=FALSE WHERE t.id=#{id} AND t.deleted=FALSE
SELECT i.*, 'ORDER_ITEM' AS source_type FROM sorting_task_item i WHERE i.task_id = #{taskId} AND i.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY i.id

WITH task_orders AS ( SELECT i.sales_order_id, MAX(i.order_no_snapshot) AS order_no_snapshot, MAX(i.customer_id) AS customer_id, MAX(i.customer_name_snapshot) AS customer_name_snapshot FROM sorting_task_item i WHERE i.task_id = #{taskId} AND i.deleted = FALSE GROUP BY i.sales_order_id ) SELECT g.id AS id, #{taskId} AS task_id, g.sales_order_id AS sales_order_id, NULL::BIGINT AS sales_order_item_id, o.order_no_snapshot AS order_no_snapshot, o.customer_id AS customer_id, o.customer_name_snapshot AS customer_name_snapshot, spu.id AS spu_id, g.sku_id AS sku_id, spu.spu_code AS spu_code_snapshot, spu.name AS product_name_snapshot, sku.sku_code AS sku_code_snapshot, sku.spec_name AS spec_name_snapshot, sku.sale_unit AS sale_unit_snapshot, 'STANDARD' AS product_type_snapshot, g.quantity AS planned_quantity_snapshot, NULL::NUMERIC AS sorted_quantity, NULL::VARCHAR AS result, NULL::VARCHAR AS reason, NULL::VARCHAR AS sorted_by, NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ AS sorted_at, 'ACTIVE' AS occupation_status, 0 AS version, 'PROMOTION_GIFT' AS source_type FROM order_promotion_gift g JOIN task_orders o ON o.sales_order_id = g.sales_order_id JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.id = g.sku_id JOIN product_spu spu ON spu.id = sku.spu_id ORDER BY g.sales_order_id, g.id

SELECT i.id AS sales_order_item_id, o.id AS sales_order_id, o.status AS order_status, o.deleted AS order_deleted, i.deleted AS item_deleted, o.order_no, o.customer_id, o.customer_name_snapshot AS customer_name, i.spu_id, i.sku_id, i.spu_code_snapshot, i.product_name_snapshot, i.sku_code_snapshot, i.spec_name_snapshot, i.sale_unit_snapshot, i.product_type_snapshot, i.actual_quantity FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE i.id IN #{lineId}
